def maxAverageOfPath(matrix):
    if not matrix or not matrix[0]:
        return 0
    
    n = len(matrix)
    
    # Create a DP table to store the maximum sum of costs up to each cell
    dp = [[float('-inf')] * n for _ in range(n)]
    
    # Initialize starting point
    dp[0][0] = matrix[0][0]
    
    # Fill first row (can only come from left)
    for j in range(1, n):
        dp[0][j] = dp[0][j-1] + matrix[0][j]
        
    # Fill first column (can only come from above)
    for i in range(1, n):
        dp[i][0] = dp[i-1][0] + matrix[i][0]
    
    # Fill the rest of the table
    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(1, n):
            dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]) + matrix[i][j]
            
    total_max_sum = dp[n-1][n-1]
    
    # Number of cells visited is always 2*N - 1 for a path from (0,0) to (N-1,N-1)
    num_cells = 2 * n - 1
    
    return round(total_max_sum / num_cells, 5)

# Test case provided in the prompt
matrix = [[1, 2, 3], [6, 5, 4], [7, 3, 9]]
result = maxAverageOfPath(matrix)

assert result == 5.2, f"Expected 5.2 but got {result}"
print(f"The maximum average is: {result}")
